senses.gloss: लुक् (I) disappearance (लुच्यते इति लुक्); a term used by Pāņini for the disappearance of an affix or its part under specified conditions as prescribed by a grammar rule with the mention of the word लुक्; e.g. प्रत्ययस्य लुक्श्र्लुलुप: P. I.1.61 ; (2) aug- ment ल् added to the root ला in the sense of melting (an oily thing); cf. घृतं विलालयति. See Kās, on P.VII.3. 39.
